queries.query: Thái Bình Viet Nam official cadastral parcel map land registry GIS service
queries.result: First-party discovery found the official VBDLIS public landing page identifying Sở TNMT Thái Bình as a participating land-information system, and the official provincial public-service portal. The current authenticated VBDLIS entry route was inspected but did not expose an anonymous parcel API.

queries.query: bản đồ địa chính thửa đất cổng thông tin chính thức tỉnh Thái Bình tra cứu đất đai
queries.result: First-party discovery found the official provincial service procedure pages describing Văn phòng đăng ký đất đai / chi nhánh as the custodian for cadastral-map extracts and land-database updates, plus the official VBDLIS service. No anonymous current parcel geometry endpoint was exposed.

registryEvidence.custodian: Sở Tài nguyên và Môi trường Thái Bình / Văn phòng đăng ký đất đai and its city branch
registryEvidence.evidence: The official VBDLIS landing page names Sở TNMT Thái Bình among deployed provincial land-information systems. The official provincial procedure page assigns cadastral-map extracts and land-database updating to Văn phòng đăng ký đất đai or its branch. This evidences local registry/procedure custody, not open parcel geometry.

sourceAssessment.service: VBDLIS public landing page and MPLIS/VBDLIS authenticated entry route
sourceAssessment.serviceDescription: Official VBDLIS public product/landing page for provincial land-information systems; the current MPLIS entry route is an authenticated restricted-government login page.
sourceAssessment.scope: Local Thái Bình registry/procedure and official VBDLIS service discovery only; no citywide anonymous parcel layer was verified.

routesAttempted.outcome: HTTP 200; HTML loaded a React landing page. Its current JavaScript bundle and static content were inspected. No parcel service URL, public feature schema, CRS, or geometry endpoint was exposed.
HTTP 200 login page; page declares a restricted government land-information system and requires username/password. No login or further requests were attempted.

Official procedure content was available through first-party discovery and records the cadastral-map-extract and database-update role of the land-registration office; it is not a parcel geometry service.

sourceAssessment.schemaAndCrs: Unverified: no anonymous parcel response was returned.

boundedPointRequest.result: Not performed because no verified anonymous parcel endpoint was exposed.
boundedPointRequest.interpretation: No inference about citywide parcel presence or absence.

uncertainty: The local registry and VBDLIS deployment are evidenced, but the public route does not provide an anonymous current parcel schema or geometry response.
The authenticated MPLIS route is a login wall; no credentials, private tokens, CAPTCHA/Cloudflare bypass, or unsafe lookup was used.

A preliminary diagnostic fetch of the authenticated host used curl -k; it was not relied on as source evidence and no certificate exception is authorized or retained as a qualification. Subsequent public-route inspection used normal TLS verification.
No exact-point hit or map-extent test was possible; this is an access limitation, not evidence of citywide absence.
No GeoJSON sample is retained because no safe native parcel ID and full native polygon were independently verified.
